text:
Ravi: Heads-up: new qint8 rerank candidate shows a ~4% MRR dip on our tail anchor slice vs int8. Need quick triage.
Maya: Which slice exactly? link?
Ravi: tail_anchors_short + synthetic near-dup set. uploaded results to internal s3.
Sam: Could be promptset duplication bleeding into holdout. labeler-bot, what's current dedupe backlog for tail_anchors_short?
labeler-bot: Golden freshness: 21 days. Dedupe backlog: 368 items. Annotator throughput: 5 FTE-equivalent. Estimated backlog clear: 6d.
Maya: OK, we should refresh a small microgolden for the rerank tail (200 samples) and prioritize near-dup detection. Also tweak sampler to surface near-duplicates.
Ravi: current sampler: python sample_cohort.py --cohort tail_anchors_short --size 500 --dedupe-window 1024 --seed 7. Change dedupe-window to 256 and rotate seeds to surface near-dupes for microgolden.
Sam: I'll coordinate a 48h labeling surge; can we borrow 1.5 FTE from retrieval ops?
Maya: I'll ask Ben. Also request Diego (quant infra) run per-layer calibration and a seed-ensemble for qint8 to check stability.
Sam: Plan: 1) Maya confirm FTE shift, 2) run per-layer qint8 + seed ensemble, 3) refresh 200 microgolden and run jittered smoke. If MRR drop persists, fallback to int8 routing for the tiered rerank.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: rerank-qint8-canary -> canary-cluster at 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z, gating: microgolden smoke pass.
Maya: Ben approved 1.5 FTE for 2 days. kicking off labeler surge.
labeler-bot: Microgolden upload path: /golden/rerank/micro200/6132471234.csv. Labeling started. ETA: ~48h.
Ravi: Diego, can you post repro artifacts here when ready?
Sam: Also add a CI guard that fails deploy if rerank MRR drops >2% on the refreshed microgolden.
Maya: noted. I'll update the handoff doc and upload sampler diff.
Ravi: thanks. keeping watch on tail recall; that's the key metric for user impact.
Diego: (later) uploaded qint8-perlayer artifacts to s3://redwood-dev/qint8/6132471234/; initial signal points to layer 11 quant noise. Running seed-ensemble now.
Maya: good — will report back when microgolden completes.
